Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Renovation/extension of an emergency department is a complex building project and therefore generally relevant for sbp. However, the project is located in Italy (not DACH) and it does not concern bridges or large-span structures, therefore only medium priority.
titel: Restricted procedure for execution design and construction works for the restructuring and extension of the emergency department of the Poggibonsi Campostaggia hospital
kurzbeschreibung: Extension and conversion of a hospital emergency department in Poggibonsi including execution design and construction works.
umfang: Conversion and extension of the emergency department of the Poggibonsi Campostaggia hospital at the Loc. Campostaggia site; structural and finishing works including building services installations; execution period 510 days. Specific areas, spans or gross floor area are not stated in the notice.
leistungen: Construction works with execution design for the restructuring and extension of the emergency department; includes construction works, building installation works and building design services.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Hospital construction is generally a relevant building type.
• However, the notice primarily concerns construction execution with execution design, not a separate structural design contract.
• No information on special structural requirements, large spans or innovative special structures.
• Project size is relatively moderate at around EUR 5.65 million.
• Strategically only of limited suitability for sbp, as the apparent focus is on general contractor / construction works aspects.
baukosten_erklaerung: Taken from the tender; the estimated contract value is stated excluding VAT, not explicitly broken down into cost groups 300 and 400.
honorar_erklaerung: No separate fee for structural design or sbp-relevant specialist design is stated. The notice only specifies a total contract value for execution design and construction works.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Registration in the commercial register; relevant educational and professional qualifications in accordance with Art. 3.4.1 of the procurement documents; SOA certificate OG1 class IV as main category and OG11 class IV as separable category; overall annual turnover over the three-year period; comparable services over the three-year period.
zuschlagskriterien: Quality; a specific weighting is not stated in the notice.
auftraggeber: AZIENDA UNITA SANITARIA LOCALE TOSCANA SUD-EST - U.O.C. LAVORI PUBBLICI SIENA, Piazza Carlo Rosselli 26, 52100 Siena, Italy, E-Mail: ausltoscanasudest@postacert.toscana.it, Tel.: 0577994076, Website: http://www.uslsudest.toscana.it/
notes: TED describes the notice as a competition, but it is in fact a restricted procedure for construction works. Procurement documents and tender / participation language exclusively Italian. Submission electronically via https://start.toscana.it. Estimated value excluding VAT: 5651922.17 EUR.
